(Please confirm current password to change Account Information)

Below you can find answers and solutions to the most common problems and questions. \nIt is very likely that there is also the answer to your problem. \nIf you cannot find any answer to your question or issues, feel free to free to contact us using the button at the bottom.
I cannot hear a song or the wrong song is playing.
My songs keep interrupting or delay playing, what is the problem?
Does Hudba use my Internet data?

You can report the song by touching the three poings next to it and clicking on "Repair this song", to try to repair it automatically. If it still does not work, click on the three dots next to the song and select "Report a problem". 
In this way it will be reported and the staff will repair the song as soon as possible. 
If a song continues to be incorrect after 48 hours from the report, contact us on the support and specify the song that is giving your problems. 
 If you want to listen to the song immediately, copy the link of the song from YouTube and paste it in the search bar.

Hudba requires a strong internet connection to stream music without slowdowns or delays. \nIf you are use Hudba on a slower WiFi or cellular connection, this may be why the app is slowing down. \nTry changing the connection to a stronger service, and play your music again.

Hudba will use internet data when playing songs. \nIf you are not connected to WiFi and you are using Hudba, your operator`s internet data plan will be used. \nHudba uses 10~15 mb of data per song played, on average.
I can`t find a song, what can i do?

You can try switching to YouTube search by tapping the button at the bottom of the search screen. \nIf you can`t find it that way, copy the link of the song from YouTube and paste it in the search bar.
The search on YouTube does not work, what can i do?
Sometimes, during peak periods, due to the huge load on our servers, YouTube search is not available.\nPlease be patient, the problem will be solved automatically after a few hours.
If I reinstall the app, will I lose my songs/playlists?
No, the metadata of the songs is saved in the cloud and associated with your account.\nWhen you log back into the app, your data will be automatically synchronized, without losing anything.
Are there any limits in the library?
No. You can currently save and listen to unlimited songs and have unlimited playlists.
How can I transfer my Hudba account to a new device?
To move the whole library, songs and playlists, you simply have to log in with the same account on the new device.
